questions.en: Low income students receiving financial aid
questions.zh: 獲得財務援助之低收入學生
questions.metricEn: Proportion of students receiving financial aid to attend university because of poverty
questions.metricZh: 因貧困而獲得助學財務援助之學生比例

options.en: Number of low income students receiving financial aid
options.zh: 獲得財務援助之低收入學生人數

questions.en:
Bottom financial quintile admission target
Targets to admit students who fall into the bottom 20% of household income group (or a more tightly defined target) in the country.
questions.zh:
最低所得五分位入學目標
貴校是否訂有招收國內最低所得 20% 家庭學生（或更嚴格定義目標）之目標？

questions.en:
Bottom financial quintile student success
Graduation/completion targets for students who fall into the bottom 20% of household income group (or a more tightly defined target) in the country.
questions.zh:
最低所得五分位學生成功
貴校是否訂有國內最低所得 20% 家庭學生（或更嚴格定義目標）之畢業／完成學業目標？

questions.en:
Low-income student support
Provide support (e.g. food, housing, transportation, legal services) for students from low income families to enable them to complete university.
questions.zh:
低收入學生支持
貴校是否提供低收入家庭學生支持（如食物、住宿、交通、法律服務），以協助其完成大學學業？

questions.en:
Bottom financial quintile student support
Programmes or initiatives to assist students who fall into the bottom 20% of household income group (or a more tightly defined target) in the country to successfully complete their studies.
questions.zh:
最低所得五分位學生支持
貴校是否有計畫或措施，協助國內最低所得 20% 家庭學生（或更嚴格定義目標）順利完成學業？

questions.en:
Low or lower-middle income countries student support
Schemes to support poor students from low or lower-middle income countries (e.g. offering free education, grants).
questions.zh:
低度／中低所得國家學生支持
貴校是否有方案支持來自低度或中低所得國家之清寒學生（如免費教育、獎助金）？

questions.en:
Local start-up assistance
Provide assistance in the local community supporting the start-up of financially and socially  sustainable businesses through relevant education or resources (e.g. mentorship programmes, training workshops, access to university facilities).
questions.zh:
地方新創協助
貴校是否透過相關教育或資源（如 mentorship、培訓工作坊、開放大學設施），協助地方社區創立財務與社會上可持續之事業？

questions.en:
Local start-up financial assistance
Provide financial assistance to the local community supporting the start-up of financially and socially sustainable businesses.
questions.zh:
地方新創財務協助
貴校是否提供地方社區財務協助，支持創立財務與社會上可持續之事業？

questions.en:
Programmes for services access
Organise training or programmes to improve access to basic services for all.
questions.zh:
基本服務近用計畫
貴校是否辦理培訓或計畫，以改善全民取得基本服務之近用？

questions.en:
Policy addressing poverty
Participate in policy making at local, regional, national and/or global level to implement programmes and policies to end poverty in all its dimensions.
questions.zh:
因應貧窮之政策參與
貴校是否參與地方、區域、國家及／或全球層級之政策制定，以推動終結各面向貧窮之計畫與政策？

questions.en:
Campus food waste tracking
Measure the amount of food waste generated from food served within the university.
questions.zh:
校園食物浪費追蹤
貴校是否量測校內供餐所產生之食物浪費量？

questions.en: Campus food waste
questions.zh: 校園食物浪費

questions.en:
Student food insecurity and hunger
Have a programme in place on student food insecurity.
questions.zh:
學生糧食不安全與飢餓
貴校是否已有因應學生糧食不安全之計畫？

questions.en:
Students hunger interventions
Provide interventions to prevent or alleviate hunger among students (e.g. including supply and access to food banks/pantries).
questions.zh:
學生飢餓介入措施
貴校是否提供介入措施以預防或減輕學生飢餓（例如食物銀行／食物儲備之供應與近用）？

questions.en:
Sustainable food choices on campus
Provide sustainable food choices for all on campus, including vegetarian and vegan food.
questions.zh:
校園永續飲食選擇
貴校是否為校園所有人提供永續飲食選擇，包括素食與純素？

questions.en:
Healthy and affordable food choices
Provide healthy and affordable food choices for all on campus.
questions.zh:
健康且可負擔之飲食選擇
貴校是否為校園所有人提供健康且可負擔之飲食選擇？

questions.en:
Staff hunger interventions
Provide interventions to prevent or alleviate hunger among members of staff (e.g. including supply and access to food banks/pantries).
questions.zh:
教職員飢餓介入措施
貴校是否提供介入措施以預防或減輕教職員飢餓（例如食物銀行／食物儲備之供應與近用）？

questions.en: Proportion of graduates in agriculture and aquaculture
questions.zh: 農業與水產養殖畢業生比例
questions.metricEn: Proportion of graduates in agriculture and aquaculture including sustainability aspects
questions.metricZh: 含永續面向之農業與水產養殖畢業生比例

options.en: Number of graduates from agriculture and aquaculture courses including sustainability aspects
options.zh: 含永續面向之農業與水產養殖課程畢業生人數

questions.en:
Access to food security knowledge
Provide access on food security and sustainable agriculture and aquaculture knowledge, skills or technology to local farmers and food producers.
questions.zh:
糧食安全知識近用
貴校是否向地方農民與食品生產者提供糧食安全及永續農漁養殖之知識、技能或技術近用？

questions.en:
Events for local farmers and food producers
Provide events for local farmers and food producers to connect and transfer knowledge
questions.zh:
地方農民與食品生產者活動
貴校是否辦理活動，供地方農民與食品生產者交流並移轉知識？

questions.en:
University access to local farmers and food producers
Provide access to university facilities (e.g. labs, technology, plant stocks) to local farmers and food producers to improve sustainable farming practices.
questions.zh:
大學設施開放予地方農民與食品生產者
貴校是否開放大學設施（如實驗室、技術、種苗）予地方農民與食品生產者，以改善永續農業實務？

questions.en:
Sustainable food purchases
Prioritise purchase of products from local, sustainable sources.
questions.zh:
永續食品採購
貴校是否優先採購來自地方、永續來源之產品？

questions.en: Proportion of graduates in health professions
questions.zh: 健康專業領域畢業生比例
questions.metricZh: 健康專業領域畢業生人數

options.en: Number of graduates in health professions
options.zh: 健康專業領域畢業生人數

questions.en:
Current collaborations with health institutions
Have current collaborations with local, national, or global health institutions to improve health and well-being outcomes.
questions.zh:
與健康機構之現行合作
貴校是否與地方、國家或全球健康機構有現行合作，以改善健康與福祉成果？

questions.en:
Health outreach programmes
Deliver outreach programmes and projects in the local community (which can include student volunteering programmes) to improve or promote health and well-being including hygiene, nutrition, family planning, sports, exercise, aging well, and other health and well-being related topics.
This can also include outreach programmes to displaced or refugee communities local to the institution.
questions.zh:
健康外展計畫
貴校是否在地方社區辦理外展計畫與專案（可含學生志工），以改善或推廣健康與福祉（含衛生、營養、家庭計畫、運動、健身、健康老化等）？亦可包含對機構所在地流離失所或難民社區之外展。

questions.en:
Shared sports facilities
Share sports facilities with the local community, for instance with local schools or with the general public.
questions.zh:
共享運動設施
貴校是否與地方社區共享運動設施（例如地方學校或一般大眾）？

questions.en:
Sexual and reproductive health care services for students
Provide students access to sexual and reproductive health-care services including information and education services.
questions.zh:
學生性與生殖健康照護服務
貴校是否提供學生性與生殖健康照護服務近用（含資訊與教育服務）？

questions.en:
Mental health support for students
Provide students with access to mental health support.
questions.zh:
學生心理健康支持
貴校是否提供學生心理健康支持之近用？

options.en: Active promotion of good mental health
Access to (or signposting to) free mental health support
options.zh: 提供（或轉介）免費心理健康支持

options.en: Access to (or signposting to) charged mental health support
options.zh: 提供（或轉介）付費心理健康支持

questions.en:
Smoke-free policy
Have a 'smoke-free' policy.
questions.zh:
無菸政策
貴校是否訂有「無菸」政策？

questions.en:
Mental health support for staff
Provide staff  with access to mental health support.
questions.zh:
教職員心理健康支持
貴校是否提供教職員心理健康支持之近用？

options.en: Active promotion of good mental health
Access to (or signposting to) free mental health support
options.zh: 提供（或轉介）免費心理健康支持

options.en: Access to (or signposting to) charged mental health support
options.zh: 提供（或轉介）付費心理健康支持

questions.en: Proportion of graduates with relevant qualification for teaching
questions.zh: 具相關教學資格之畢業生比例
questions.metricEn: Proportion of graduates with teaching qualification
questions.metricZh: 具教學資格之畢業生比例

options.en: Number of graduates who gained a qualification that entitled them to teach at primary school level
options.zh: 取得可於小學任教資格之畢業生人數

questions.en:
Public resources (lifelong learning)
Provide free access to educational resources for those not studying at the university.
questions.zh:
公共資源（終身學習）
貴校是否為非在校就讀者提供免費教育資源近用？

options.en: Free courses leading to certificate or award
options.zh: 可取得證書或獎項之免費課程

options.en: Free access to campus facilities and equipment
options.zh: 免費使用校園設施與設備

questions.en:
Public events (lifelong learning)
Host educational events at university that are open to the general public.
questions.zh:
公開活動（終身學習）
貴校是否在校內舉辦對一般大眾開放之教育活動？

questions.en:
Vocational training events (lifelong learning)
Host events at university that are open to the general public: executive education programmes (this refers to short courses for people who are not attending the university; this specifically excludes courses like MBA) and/or vocational training.
questions.zh:
職業訓練活動（終身學習）
貴校是否舉辦對一般大眾開放之活動：高階主管教育（指非在校生之短期課程，不含 MBA 等）及／或職業訓練？

questions.en:
Education outreach activities beyond campus
Undertake educational outreach activities (e.g. tailored lectures or demonstrations) beyond campus - in local schools, in the community. This can include voluntary student-run schemes.
questions.zh:
校園外教育外展活動
貴校是否在校園外（地方學校、社區）辦理教育外展活動（如客製講座或示範）？可含學生志工方案。

questions.en:
Lifelong learning access policy
A policy that ensures that access to these activities is accessible to all, regardless of ethnicity, religion, disability immigration status or gender.
questions.zh:
終身學習近用政策
貴校是否訂有政策，確保上述活動近用不受族群、宗教、身心障礙、移民身分或性別影響？

questions.en: Proportion of first-generation students
questions.zh: 第一代大學生比例

options.en: Number of students starting a degree
options.zh: 開始修讀學位之學生人數

options.en: Number of first-generation students starting a degree
options.zh: 開始修讀學位之第一代大學生人數

questions.en: Proportion of women first-generation
questions.zh: 第一代女性比例
questions.metricZh: 第一代女性大學生比例

options.en: Number of women starting a degree
options.zh: 開始修讀學位之女性人數

options.en: Number of first-generation women starting a degree
options.zh: 開始修讀學位之第一代女性大學生人數

questions.en:
Tracking access measures
Systematically measure and track women's application rate, acceptance or entry rate.
questions.zh:
近用追蹤措施
貴校是否系統性量測並追蹤女性申請率、錄取率或入學率？

questions.en:
Policy for women applications and entry
Have a policy (e.g. an Access and Participation plan) addressing women's applications, acceptance, entry, and participation at the university.
questions.zh:
女性申請與入學政策
貴校是否訂有政策（如近用與參與計畫），處理女性申請、錄取、入學與參與？

questions.en:
Women's access schemes
Provide women's access schemes, including mentoring, scholarships, or other provision
questions.zh:
女性近用方案
貴校是否提供女性近用方案（含 mentorship、獎學金或其他措施）？

questions.en:
Women's application in underrepresented subjects
Encourage applications by women in subjects where they are underrepresented. Through university outreach or through collaboration with other universities, community groups, government or NGOs in regional or national campaigns.
questions.zh:
女性於代表性不足學科之申請
貴校是否鼓勵女性申請其代表性不足之學科？可透過大學外展，或與其他大學、社區團體、政府或 NGO 之區域／全國宣導合作。

options.en: through collaboration with other universities and/or community groups and/or government     and/or NGOs in regional or national campaigns
options.zh: 透過與其他大學、社區團體、政府及／或 NGO 之區域或全國性合作宣導

questions.en: Proportion of senior female academics
questions.zh: 女性資深學術人員比例
questions.metricZh: 女性資深學術人員比例

options.en: Number of female senior academic staff
options.zh: 女性資深學術人員人數

questions.en: Proportion of female degrees awarded
questions.zh: 女性獲頒學位比例

options.en: Number of graduates by subject area (STEM, Medicine, Arts & Humanities / Social Sciences): Total
options.zh: 依學科領域畢業生人數（STEM、醫學、藝術人文／社會科學）：合計

options.en: Number of graduates: Arts & Humanities / Social Sciences
options.zh: 畢業生人數：藝術人文／社會科學

options.en: Number of female graduates by subject area (STEM, Medicine, Arts & Humanities / Social Sciences): Total
options.zh: 依學科領域女性畢業生人數（STEM、醫學、藝術人文／社會科學）：合計

options.en: Number of female graduates: Arts & Humanities / Social Sciences
options.zh: 女性畢業生人數：藝術人文／社會科學

questions.en:
Policy of non-discrimination against women
Have a policy of non-discrimination against women
questions.zh:
禁止歧視女性政策
貴校是否訂有禁止歧視女性之政策？

questions.en:
Non-discrimination policies for transgender
Have a policy of non-discrimination for transgender people.
questions.zh:
跨性別不歧視政策
貴校是否訂有對跨性別者不歧視之政策？

questions.en:
Maternity policy
Have a maternity policy that support women's participation.
questions.zh:
產假／孕產政策
貴校是否訂有支持女性參與之孕產相關政策？

questions.en:
Childcare facilities for students
Have accessible childcare facilities for students which allow recent mothers to attend university
courses.
questions.zh:
學生托育設施
貴校是否提供學生可近用之托育設施，使甫生產之母親能修課？

questions.en:
Childcare facilities for staff and faculty
Have childcare facilities for staff and faculty
questions.zh:
教職員托育設施
貴校是否為教職員提供托育設施？

questions.en:
Women's mentoring schemes
Have women's mentoring schemes, in which at least 10% of female students participate.
questions.zh:
女性 mentorship 方案
貴校是否有女性 mentorship 方案，且至少 10% 女性學生參與？

questions.en:
Track women's graduation rate
Have measurement or tracking of women's likelihood of graduating compared to men's, and schemes in place to close any gap.
questions.zh:
追蹤女性畢業率
貴校是否量測／追蹤女性相對男性之畢業可能性，並有縮小差距之方案？

questions.en:
Policies protecting those reporting discrimination
Have a policy that protects those reporting discrimination from educational or employment disadvantage
questions.zh:
保護檢舉歧視者之政策
貴校是否訂有政策，保護檢舉歧視者不致遭受教育或就業不利？

questions.en:
Paternity policy
Have a paternity policy that supports women's participation by ensuring that fathers can participate in childcare duties
questions.zh:
陪產／育嬰假政策
貴校是否訂有陪產／育嬰相關政策，確保父親可參與育兒以支持女性參與？

questions.en:
Measure the total volume of water used in the university that is taken from mains supply,
desalinated, or extracted from rivers, lakes, or aquifers?
questions.zh: 貴校是否量測自來水、淡化水，或自河川、湖泊、含水層抽取之總用水量？

questions.en: Water consumption per person
questions.zh: 人均用水量

options.en: Volume of water used in the university: Inbound (treated/extracted water)
options.zh: 大學用水量：進水量（處理／抽取水）

questions.en:
Wastewater treatment
A process in place to treat wastewater.
questions.zh:
廢水處理
貴校是否已有廢水處理程序？

questions.en:
Preventing water system pollution
Processes to prevent polluted water entering the water system, including pollution caused by accidents and incidents at the university.
questions.zh:
防止水系統污染
貴校是否有程序防止污染水進入水系統（含校內事故與事件造成之污染）？

questions.en:
Free drinking water provided
Provide free drinking water for students, staff and/or visitors (e.g. drinking water fountains).
questions.zh:
免費飲用水
貴校是否為學生、教職員及／或訪客提供免費飲用水（如飲水機）？

questions.en:
Water-conscious building standards
Apply building standards to minimise water use
questions.zh:
節水建築標準
貴校是否採用建築標準以最小化用水？

questions.en:
Water-conscious planting
Plant landscapes to minimise water usage. (e.g. use drought-tolerant plants)
questions.zh:
節水植栽
貴校是否以最小化用水方式規劃景觀植栽（如耐旱植物）？

questions.en:
Water reuse policy
Have a policy to maximise water reuse across the university?
questions.zh:
水再利用政策
貴校是否訂有最大化全校水再利用之政策？

questions.en:
Water reuse measurement
Measure the reuse of water across the university?
questions.zh:
水再利用量測
貴校是否量測全校水再利用情形？

questions.en:
Water management educational opportunities
Provide educational opportunities for local communities to learn about good water management
questions.zh:
水資源管理教育機會
貴校是否為地方社區提供優良水資源管理之教育機會？

questions.en:
Off-campus water conservation support
Support practical water conservation off campus
questions.zh:
校外節水支持
貴校是否支持校外實務節水？

questions.en:
Sustainable water extraction on campus
Where water is extracted (for example from aquifers, lakes or rivers) utilise sustainable water extraction technologies on associated university grounds on and off campus.
questions.zh:
校園永續取水
若有取水（如自含水層、湖泊或河川），貴校是否在相關校地（校內外）使用永續取水技術？

questions.en:
Cooperation on water security
Cooperate with local, regional, national, or global governments on water security.
questions.zh:
水安全合作
貴校是否與地方、區域、國家或全球政府就水安全合作？

questions.en:
Promoting conscious water usage on campus
Actively promote conscious water usage on campus,
questions.zh:
校園推廣節水意識用水
貴校是否積極在校園推廣有意識之用水？

questions.en:
Promoting conscious water usage in the wider community.
